# vulnerable-app (test fixture)

**Intentionally vulnerable. Never deploy or run this app.** It is inert test data for the sask benchmark. It contains exactly 5 seeded vulnerabilities, each marked `SEEDED VULN` in `app.py` and listed in `../expected.json`. All credentials are fake.

Excluded from ruff, Semgrep and Gitleaks scans of the sask repo itself.
